title: Wanderer in Neon Vortex
description: A man in a long coat stands on cracked ground holding a briefcase labeled 'WANDER' while facing a massive swirling vortex of fiery red, orange, yellow and green flames. Two large signs reading 'WANDER' float in the turbulent sky above a chain-link fence and shopping cart filled with objects.
